description: A Scala 3 library for type-safe JDBC access using plain SQL.
rules: Use a JDBC DataSource to create a SqueryContext; JDBC drivers are separate dependencies and are not bundled.

Interpolate runtime values with sql strings so they become prepared-statement parameters. Only interpolate trusted compile-time literal strings or Query fragments as SQL; never use untrusted input as SQL syntax.
Import the database-specific ba.sake.squery.<database> givens when you need that database's codecs.
For derived SqlReadRow case classes and named tuples, match field names to selected column names; nested join fields use column prefixes, and use Option for nullable outer-join rows.
Use ctx.run for scoped connection access and ctx.runTransaction when statements must commit or roll back together.
Query.in with an empty collection generates (NULL), which is suitable for IN but should not be used with NOT IN. Query.values requires at least one row.
The code-generation CLI does not bundle JDBC drivers. SQLite code generation uses the main schema; generated RETURNING requires SQLite 3.35+, and STRICT tables require SQLite 3.37+.
